name: chat-message
title: Chat message
description: One message: the person's words exactly as typed, on the right, with the chips they sent; the agent's words through the host's renderer, on the left, outlined while said partway through a turn.

attributes.data-interim: the agent's words partway through a turn

methods.show(entry, render): draws one person or agent entry from the feed's core

whenNotToUse: System lines and change chips (the feed's own rows).
accessibility: A hidden 'You:' or 'Agent:' leads the words. Chips are a list named 'Sent with it'.
